verdict.rationale: Atlas documents access to legal documents developed with the startup law firm Cooley. Its incorporation and setup templates were also created with Cooley, and SAFEs can be created from the Dashboard. A community member confirms a vetted operating agreement. However, the evidence centers on formation and fundraising documents rather than a browsable library of routine documents like NDAs, commercial agreements, or policies. missing for 10: evidence of a general template library covering NDAs, contractor or commercial agreements and policies, and details of the template catalog's scope and customization.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents

citations.quote: It also gives you access to legal documents developed with Cooley (a law firm for startups)
Atlas helps you set up a company using templates created in collaboration with Cooley LLP.
creating, sending, and tracking Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs) from your Dashboard
a fully vetted operating agreement suited for an internet company
